## Description and Rationale

Solo team: Luis Melzer, CS student at Leibniz Universität Hannover specializing in machine learning. A recent AutoML competition sparked my passion for applied ML on real-world data. I registered for the PRC challenge because predicting taxi-out times offers a focused prediction problem with tangible environmental relevance.
